report.title: 标签与内容之间有多个空格时，只保留了一个空格
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Demo site (demo.usememos.com) ### Memos Version v0.25.3 ### Bug Description 标签与内容之间有多个空格时，只保留了一个空格 ### Steps to Reproduce 1. 输入，发布 ``` #tag content ``` 2. 输入，标签与内容之间有多个空格，发布 ``` #tag content ``` 渲染结果多个空格消失了，不符合预期: ### Expected Behavior 期望输入与实际渲染一致 ### Screenshots & Additional Context _No response_

preconditions: the memo editor is available on the home page
no memos exist yet on the fresh install
steps: Click the memo editor input box on the home page
Type "#tag content" (one space between the tag and the word)
Click the Save/Publish button to publish the memo
Click the memo editor input box again
Type "#tag" followed by 24 space characters and then "content"
Click the Save/Publish button to publish the memo
Look at how the second published memo is rendered in the memo list, comparing the gap between "#tag" and "content" with the first memo
plan.expected: In the second published memo, "content" appears after "#tag" with a visibly wider gap than in the first memo, so the multiple spaces typed are preserved.
plan.reported_actual: The multiple spaces between the tag and the content are collapsed into a single space in the rendered memo, so it looks the same as the single-space memo.
missing: assumed: the number of spaces in the reporter's second example is 24
assumed: the reporter used the default memo editor on the home page and the memo was visible in the memo list after publishing
Does the rendered memo keep the extra spaces after re-opening it in edit mode (is it only a rendering issue)?
Does the same collapsing happen between plain words, or only after a tag?
plan.summary: Multiple spaces between a #tag and following text render as a single space in the memo
